messages.subject: Campus Drive: Palisade Security - Security Analyst (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Palisade Security is hiring Security Analysts (CTC 9 LPA).
Eligibility: CSE, IT | CGPA 7.0 and above | No active backlogs.
Register here: https://forms.gle/palisadeSA by 11:59 PM, 22 September 2026.

Regards,
Career Office

messages.subject: IMPORTANT: Palisade Security role title corrected
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Note: the Palisade Security role announced earlier is officially titled 'Cybersecurity Analyst', not 'Security Analyst'. This is the same drive, same eligibility, same deadline as before. No new registration needed if you already applied.

Regards,
Career Office
